metrics.investment_case_interpretation: UBA Investments is itself an investment company. After discounting listed securities and group cash, the discounted liquidation-style net cash/assets exceed the rough market cap, but there is no positive ordinary-business distributable cash-profit denominator once dividend income is matched against overhead and FVTPL gains are treated as asset revaluation/portfolio rotation. It therefore belongs in liquidation_watch rather than profit_cheap.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All cash is HKD and no restriction was disclosed, but parent-company cash is only HK$0.566m while most cash sits in investment holding subsidiaries, so a subsidiary extraction discount is applied.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 18 and consolidated statement of financial position disclose HK$30.578m cash and cash equivalents.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed equity securities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed Level 1 securities are readily realisable, but they are also the company's core investment business assets and are exposed to market/liquidity risk, so a listed-securities liquidation discount is used.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 17 discloses listed equity securities of HK$62.565m and says they are classified current because management expects to realise them within twelve months.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The balance represents client monies held by related licensed securities companies, unsecured and interest-free with no fixed repayment terms; amount is small but related-party custody lowers certainty.
Current financial liability at amortised cost; deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 6 liquidity table and consolidated statement of financial position.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: One year of administrative and other operating expenses is reserved to maintain listing, management, custody, staff and office operations.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report consolidated statement of profit or loss discloses administrative and other operating expenses of HK$5.124m.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, trading, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for market execution, distribution and control extraction friction; tax charge was nil in 2025 but liquidation or portfolio sales still need friction allowance.
cash_breakdown.reason: Estimate based on investment-company asset realisation path and annual report tax note showing no current tax provision.

profit_quality.assessment: No ordinary operating-business cash-profit denominator is available. The company has one investment-holding segment; 2025 profit was driven by fair value gains on FVTPL assets and dividends from listed securities. Since the listed securities and cash are already treated as detachable/liquidation assets, their unrealised gains, realised gains and related income are not double-counted as sustainable operating profit.
adjustments: Excluded HK$10.228m FVTPL fair value gains because they are revaluation/portfolio trading returns on assets already included in the liquidation asset pool.
Excluded HK$0.310m bank interest because the cash principal is included in detachable net cash.
Dividend income HK$5.042m is not enough to cover administrative and other operating expenses HK$5.124m before relying on portfolio gains.
Operating cash flow HK$24.531m is not used as recurring cash profit because it includes HK$24.456m decrease in FVTPL assets.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Reported operating cash flow is positive, but mainly from reducing the investment portfolio rather than recurring free cash generation.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Investment-company earnings are market-price dependent and not separable from the asset base being deducted; no positive recurring distributable cash-profit denominator remains after overhead.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported OCF does not support recurring profit because portfolio disposals are included in operating movements.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No material capital expenditure identified; ordinary operations are asset-management/listing overhead rather than fixed-asset intensive operations.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working-capital movement is dominated by FVTPL financial asset turnover, not customer receivables or inventory.
